purpose: A deterministic homologous-field comparison of frozen Pair A and Pair B; it does not encode or test an airway-versus-brain hypothesis.

pair_scope.replacement_policy: FORBIDDEN; no trait or pair may be substituted after seeing a result
pair_scope.biological_axis_hypothesis: NONE; airway-versus-brain and every other narrative label are post-comparison interpretations outside this executor

comparison_dimensions.homology_rule: Compare A and B only within the identical queried sleep trait and evidence layer; never compare a locus row to a variant/gene/global row.

upstream_gate.requirements: The complete 96-row A/B Phase24 family and separately sealed 48-row CONTROL family must validate against the Phase24 contract and one provenance commit. Global-rg-only, partial-layer, partial-trait, header-only, synthetic, or unsealed inputs are forbidden.

rules: If either input status is BLOCKED or FAILED, outcome is BLOCKED.
If both statuses are NOT_APPLICABLE, outcome is NOT_APPLICABLE; one-sided NOT_APPLICABLE is BLOCKED_NONCOMPARABLE.
If both statuses are TESTED_NO_SUPPORT, outcome is NO_DETECTED_SUPPORT; this is not an equivalence or biological-null claim.
If exactly one status is SUPPORTED and the other is TESTED_NO_SUPPORT, outcome is DISTINCT.
For GLOBAL_RG_CONTEXT only, two SUPPORTED statuses are SHARED at the phenotype-pattern level and never at locus, variant, gene, or mechanism level.
For non-global layers, two SUPPORTED statuses are SHARED when their complete supported-entity sets intersect and DISTINCT when they are disjoint.
A SHARED row may retain pair-specific entities; shared and pair-specific sets are reported without ranking or truncation.
comparison_algorithm.effect_size_contrast: NOT_ESTIMATED; different external phenotypes make an unmodelled numeric A-minus-B contrast scientifically invalid
comparison_algorithm.direction_concordance: Reported descriptively only when both homologous rows expose comparable directions; it never changes the five-class outcome
comparison_algorithm.tie_breaking: NONE; sets are canonical lexicographic order and no best row is selected

status_semantics.SUPPORTED: At least one entity met the preregistered upstream rule in a complete corrected family.
status_semantics.TESTED_NO_SUPPORT: The complete preregistered upstream family was tested and had no entity meeting the support rule; power and QC remain explicit, and this is not a biological null.
status_semantics.NOT_APPLICABLE: A checksum-locked upstream-zero state proves no eligible family existed.
status_semantics.BLOCKED: Required data, lock, software, denominator, or coverage is absent; no scientific result exists.
status_semantics.FAILED: Execution or validation failed; it remains a failure and is never a null.

phase25_multiple_testing.rule: Phase25 is a deterministic comparison of upstream categorical evidence and performs no new hypothesis test, p-value subtraction, p-value combination, or correction.

control_contract.claim_limit: CONTROL assesses recovery/calibration only and cannot support novelty or a Pair-A-versus-Pair-B biological narrative.

output_contract.row_count_rule: At least one row per fixed comparison dimension; when support exists, one row per entity in the complete A/B union, without ranking or truncation.
output_contract.publication: atomic no-replace; byte-identical partial output may resume; provenance is the last commit artifact

claim_limits.phase: The output describes only the two frozen pairs under homologous evidence definitions. It is not a general sleep taxonomy, an airway-versus-brain test, evidence of causality, or evidence that a shared locus/variant/gene has the same mechanism.
claim_limits.blocked: BLOCKED means non-comparable, not equal, different, null, negative, or nonsignificant.
claim_limits.no_detected_support: NO_DETECTED_SUPPORT means neither complete family crossed its preregistered support rule. No equivalence margin or powered equivalence test is defined, so NULL is not an allowed outcome.
